note: Synthetic adversarial cases from the 2026-09-27 Adversarial Case Lab (R03 v2), corrected per claude-tasks/task-06. No real customer data. AC-01 and AC-03 are deterministic custom-scenario fixtures; AC-02 is an evaluator/ambiguity sentinel only (the v0.1 rule library has no generic SME capacity trigger, and none is invented here). Arithmetic pins are descriptive calculations, not lender-policy thresholds.

intake.dealName: AC-01 — Profitable refinance with aged creditors (synthetic)
intake.scenario: Profitable SME refinance with low headline leverage but material aged supplier arrears and a partially specified working-capital request
intake.borrower: Company; commercial cleaning and facilities services
intake.purpose: $650,000 refinance existing business debt; $250,000 working capital
intake.security: First mortgage over director-owned residential property
intake.existingDebts: Existing business term debt to be refinanced; existing property debt $500,000; supplier arrears over 90 days $310,000
intake.conduct: ATO current; SG claimed current by the director; bank conduct summary provided by client
intake.documents: FY24/FY25 financials; 3 months business bank statements; existing facility statement; property estimate
intake.urgency: Wants to settle the refinance this quarter

intake.dealName: AC-02 — Low-LVR commercial refinance, weak capacity (synthetic sentinel)
intake.scenario: Low-LVR owner-occupied commercial refinance where strong property security sits beside weak operating debt-service capacity
intake.purpose: Refinance business term debt and consolidate equipment obligations
intake.security: First mortgage over related-entity commercial property
intake.income: FY25 revenue $2,950,000; FY25 adjusted EBITDA $260,000; stated combined annual debt service $300,000 (existing $72,000 plus proposed $228,000)
intake.existingDebts: Business term debt and equipment finance to be consolidated
intake.conduct: ATO current; SG current per management; bank conduct summary provided by client
intake.documents: FY24/FY25 financials; 6 months bank statements; property estimate; equipment debt schedule
intake.urgency: Refinance before the equipment facilities roll over

AC-02.proxyLabel: EBITDA / stated debt service is an analytical proxy only — not a lender DSCR or policy threshold.

intake.dealName: AC-03 — MCA refinance with remediation path (synthetic)
intake.scenario: Profitable wholesale business seeks to refinance a merchant cash advance and add working capital after a temporary inventory build
intake.security: General security agreement plus director guarantee; no property security assumed
intake.existingDebts: Merchant cash advance: payout $300,000, repayments $10,500 per week
intake.conduct: Two account excesses during the peak inventory month; ATO current; SG current per supplied summary
intake.documents: FY24/FY25 financials; 3 months bank statements; MCA balance screenshot; inventory report
intake.urgency: Wants the MCA cleared as soon as possible

AC-03.reductionLabel: Nominal annual repayment reduction — not free cash flow and not proof of serviceability.
